findings.what: Verified projection can be replaced between verification and query.

findings.what: Path containment checks are vulnerable to symlink swap races.
findings.why: Containment relies on pathname prechecks in _safe_input_file and the derived-artifact helpers, but callers subsequently reopen those names with read_bytes, mkdir, write_text, duckdb.connect, unlink, and os.replace. The staging names are fixed and predictable. A process that can mutate a shared case directory can replace a checked input or staging component with a symlink between check and use, causing an out-of-root read or a DuckDB or manifest write outside .anomaly/search, including a canonical-evidence target. The existing test covers only a symlink present before the check, not the reachable swap race.
